quests.title: Wangshu Take-Away

dialogue.sit: I'd love to, but I have to get going.

dialogue.t: Well, have it then. I'll figure something out.

dialogue.sit: I'll take care of it right now.

dialogue.t: You have my thanks. But you know Almond Tofu. You shake it around a bit, and it falls apart.
So be careful, now. Don't just run, climb or fly around any old how you like.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Laid Back Ling'guan

dialogue.t: My food should be showing up any minute now...

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: That's right. Ling'guan asked for some Almond Tofu before heading off to Mingyun Village again.
It's an odd place, Mingyun Village is.
In any case, I hope to get someone who can help me deliver it to her.
Hehe, thanks. I'm surprised that Wangshu Inn delivers this far out...

quests.description: Wangshu Inn has a special order that needs sending out...
